name: crawl-frontier-core
scope: The whole spec. Owns every operation of the CrawlFrontier protocol (src protocol.clj) and all state named by role in README.md and test-resources/IMPLICIT_SPEC.md: canonical URL dedup, per-host lex-ordered queues, host policy, host clock, fenced leases, and claim outcomes. All requirements, bounds, workloads, and edge cases bind by reference to those files; nothing is restated here.
